gloss: to suffer from (an illness); to be ill

definitions.gloss: to suffer from (an illness); to be ill
definitions.explanation: To be afflicted with a disease or long-term medical condition. More formal and literary than {病気|びょうき}になる, and usually implies a serious or prolonged illness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧{患|わずら}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He has been ill for a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病|やまい}→病：13610_yamai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{患|わずら}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My father suffered from a heart condition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大病|たいびょう}→大病：12198_taibyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{患|わずら}って⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}った→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: After suffering a serious illness, I came to understand the importance of health.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧); the illness is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.
- Pattern: [illness]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{患|わずら}う

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{病|やまい}→病：13610_yamai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{患|わずら}う: to suffer from a disease
- ⟦{大病|たいびょう}→大病：12198_taibyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{患|わずら}う: to suffer a serious illness
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{患|わずら}う: to be ill for many years

NOTE: As a verb suffix, わずらう attaches to the masu-stem to mean "have trouble doing," as in ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧{煩|わずら}う (to fret) or ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧{煩|わずら}う (to struggle to say).
